description.en: An agent-ready React design system from Meta, built on StyleX with customizable themes.
description.zh: Meta 开源的 Agent 友好型 React 设计系统，基于 StyleX 构建，内置 150+ 无障碍组件与多套主题预设。

content.en: Astryx is Meta's open-source design system engineered for both human engineers and AI coding agents. Powered by StyleX and React, it brings over 150 accessible, production-tested primitives, pre-built application templates, and a zero-runtime CSS footprint. Standout capabilities include dedicated AI chat composers, rich streaming text primitives, design tokens with instant multi-theme swapping, and an agent-first CLI that scaffolds and swizzles components directly into your repository.
content.zh: Astryx 是 Meta 经过内部数千个项目实战验证后开源的设计系统，专为现代开发者与 AI Coding Agent 协同工作打造。依托 React 与 StyleX 零运行时样式引擎，Astryx 提供了 150 多个高度无障碍的原子组件与现成全流程模板。其亮点在于深度拥抱 AI 原生交互（如 AI 对话输入框、流式打字输出与思维链状态提示）、基于设计令牌的即时多主题切换，以及能够将组件源码与规范无缝注入项目的 Agent 友好型 CLI 工具。
